title: Get a quote for workers insurance
summary: Use the quote tool provided by iCare to estimate your workers compensation premium if you are an employer in NSW.
intro:
Insurance and Care NSW (icare) provides a quote tool to help you estimate your workers compensation premium.

If you are an employer in NSW you must have a workers insurance policy unless you are considered an ‘exempt employer'.

You may be exempt if:

Even if you are exempt, if one of your workers is injured you must provide assistance with injury management and return to work.
who_can_apply: belong to a group for workers insurance purposes
have estimated annual wages of $7,500 or less
what_you_need: your business activity or your Workers Compensation Industry Classification (WIC)
your total number of employees and annual wages
contractors (total number, contract type and value, labour costs)
workers exposed to asbestos (total number and wages, description of work)

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to get a quote.

more_info.text: Details provided on contractors and/or workers exposed to asbestos will be included in your premium when you take out a policy.

faqs.a: Yes, if you are an employer in NSW, you must have a workers insurance policy unless you are considered an ‘exempt employer’.

faqs.q: What happens if I am exempt from workers insurance?
faqs.a: Even if you are exempt, if one of your workers is injured, you must provide assistance with injury management and return to work.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to use the quote tool?
faqs.a: The quote tool can help estimate premiums for employers who employ contractors, belong to a group for workers insurance purposes, have estimated annual wages of $7,500 or less, work with asbestos, or are involved in coal mining.
